messages.body_plain:
Hi Graham,

I just uploaded the last package for this transition.

A bunch of packages still have their autopkgtests failing because I gave 
priority to uploads over fixing tests.

Also, the next Bioconductor transition is probably going to start at the 
end of the month.  Fortunately, it should be a very easy one since I 
cleared a lot of backlog and bitrot, and there is no clash with other 
transitions at the moment.

With this said, I would appreciate your guidance on the next steps.

Have a nice day,

Charles

Hi Charles

Your last email [1] did not make it into my mailbox, but I just saw it
in the bug report.

Please upload r-bioc-biocgenerics dropping 'skip-not-installable' in
the autopkgtests, then let's consider this transition done and
packages can migrate as soon as their autopkgtests are green.

Regards
Graham
